note: Social links on public profiles (server/accounts/socials.js). HANDLE ONLY: the player types a handle, Everstats builds the link from 'url' ({handle} is replaced, URL-encoded), so no free-text URL is ever shown. 'pattern' is the platform's handle format (checked 2026-11-09; sources in the comments); 'help' is said back when a handle doesn't match. Icons: none shipped (text labels); see CLAUDE.md 'Profiles'. Raider.IO and Warcraft Logs are not here: Raider.IO's Forever site links CHARACTERS (forever.raider.io/characters/us/{ruleset}/{name}), not players, and Warcraft Logs' Forever URL pattern couldn't be confirmed.

platforms.label: Twitch
platforms.help: A Twitch username: 4–25 letters, digits or underscores, not starting with an underscore.
platforms.source: No official Twitch page states it; widely documented as 4–25 [A-Za-z0-9_] (discuss.dev.twitch.com)

platforms.label: YouTube
platforms.help: A YouTube @handle: 3–30 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores, not starting or ending with a dot, hyphen or underscore.

platforms.label: X
platforms.help: An X username: up to 15 letters, digits or underscores.

platforms.label: Bluesky
platforms.help: A Bluesky handle is a domain name, like name.bsky.social.

platforms.label: Kick
platforms.help: A Kick username: 3–25 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
platforms.source: No official Kick rule found; third-party sources disagree (3–20 vs 4–24), so this accepts the union

platforms.label: TikTok
platforms.help: A TikTok username: 2–24 letters, digits, underscores or dots, not ending with a dot.
platforms.source: No official TikTok page found; secondary sources (24 characters, letters digits _ ., no trailing dot)

platforms.label: Instagram
platforms.help: An Instagram username: up to 30 letters, digits, dots or underscores, without a dot at either end or two in a row.
platforms.source: No official Instagram page found; secondary sources

platforms.label: Discord server
platforms.help: A Discord invite code: the part after discord.gg/ (letters, digits and hyphens).
platforms.source: support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/115001542132 (vanity codes); exact character set not published
